data.long_meaning: The name Barimah is derived from the Hebrew language. It is composed of two parts: 'Bari' meaning 'strong' or 'strength' and 'mah' meaning 'son'. Thus, the name Barimah means 'Son of strength'. This name was borne by a Levite in the Old Testament. The name Barimah carries the meaning “Son of strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barimah usually hope their child will grow to embody son of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barimah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
